items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: I also played with Nick Beninati too.

ctx.x: Well, there's a lot of good drummers left. But yeah.

And then, I had been also playing with old Dominic Barocco. He's still playing the banjo and then there's this old violin player. He's a little bit of a guitar player. He's a little bit of a guitar player. His name is Lloyd Chapman. He has an amplifier on his violin. He knows all the old tunes from way back then. His wife was a real fine piano player. She died. And, uh, I had, so I played with them about three weeks ago. It was the weather. I also played with Nick Beninati too. He's a fondle of the trumpet man.…
Was he with, did he play with Nick? Henry Wilde. Yeah, yeah.
